summary_markdown: Someone inquired about the `/api/campaigns/target/total-traffic` endpoint, specifically confirming if there was a dependency requiring `db-period` to be a multiple of 4. [me] confirmed that any period is acceptable. The range for this parameter will now be set from 1 to 12.
decisions: The `/api/campaigns/target/total-traffic` endpoint accepts any value for `db-period`, not just multiples of 4.
